# Clerk Concepts and Components

_Discovery source: [Clerk's language-model documentation index](https://clerk.com/docs/llms.txt)_

Use this reference when choosing Clerk architecture, prebuilt components, custom flows, appearance, localization, or account-management surfaces.

## Operating Guidance

- Choose prebuilt components when their product contract fits. Build a custom flow only when the product needs control the component contract cannot provide.
- Treat Clerk frontend state as presentation and interaction state. Server authorization still owns access decisions.
- Keep provider configuration centralized and preserve framework rendering boundaries.
- Localize Clerk's vocabulary when the product uses different user-facing terms, and verify every mounted Clerk surface.
